study type: Retrospective analysis of a clinical series
outcome: intraoperative hemorrhage during ultrasound-guided suction curettage
time for serum b-hCG to return to normal levels
cohort: Seventy-six patients diagnosed with Caesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP).
finding: Gestational sac size positively correlated with HIFU treatment parameters (time, intensity, power, sonication time) and blood loss during suction curettage, indicating it is a meaningful predictor for the efficacy and safety of HIFU combined with ultrasound-guided suction curettage for CSP.
